sourceEvidence.boundary: Historical source and v15 captures are visual references, not fresh v16 audit captures. The original scene shows human enemies; the current product keeps original mechanical guards.

diagnosis: The large smooth shoulder bulbs and single symmetric chest block make the guard read as a toy even when the joints are connected.
Uniform flat colour and a bright receiver hide mechanical divisions and make the first-person weapon look unfinished.
The warm doorway suggests depth, but approaching guards need contact shadows and quieter material breakup.
implemented: Fitted superelliptical shoulder shells, paired chest leaves, segmented abdomen, overlapping hip plates and recessed front fasteners.
Armoured elbow and knee caps over ribbed flexible joint sleeves; fitted forearm/shin panels and toe guards retain the same joint origins.
Machined receiver seams, side charging lever, small hex fasteners, handguard recesses and limited edge abrasion use actual geometry.
Locally authored 512px coating, brushed-metal and rubber maps provide low contrast colour variation, roughness and shallow bump detail.
A real shadow-casting spotlight supplies a directional patrol pool between the cool cabinets and warm entry.
Experience state reports the actual current weapon, guard and room art metadata.

preserved.combat: The centre-camera ray, actual room surfaces, firing/recoil presentation, directional melee and visible-warning wall clock are unchanged.

verification.syntax: defense.js, defense-detail.js and defense-finish.js parsed successfully in Node.
verification.geometryResult: Finite constructed positions/UVs/normals, actual centre-body intersection and unchanged joint offsets in all four attack phases passed.
verification.visualAndInteraction: Completed by root in the actual in-app browser. See notes/v16-in-app-verification.json for per-case controls, current-canvas PNGs and explicit limits.

remaining: These are authored real-time geometric guards and weapon parts. The source game meshes, character animation library and scanned environment are not reproduced.
The local material marks are subtle procedural finishes; browser inspection is required before judging their visual quality.
The extra patrol shadow adds rendering work; no frame-rate or physical-device performance claim is made.
